name: Rasterizing Bounding Geometry for Empty Space Skipping
definition: Exploits hardware-accelerated rasterization to skip over empty space by rasterizing bounding geometries, e.g., bounding boxes of leaf nodes of a tree structure.
summary: Rasterizing Bounding Geometry for Empty Space Skipping is a volume rendering optimization that uses hardware-accelerated rasterization to determine ray marching start and end positions, replacing expensive tree traversal with depth testing.
